definitions.explanation: A device that combines multiple functions such as printing, scanning, copying, and sometimes faxing into a single unit. Standard equipment in Japanese offices and increasingly common in homes.

examples.japanese: {複合機|ふくごうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コピーした→コピーする：02941_kopiisuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a copy on the multi-function printer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{複合機|ふくごうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{両面|りょうめん}{印刷|いんさつ}→両面印刷：08136_ryoumeninsatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This multi-function printer can do double-sided printing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{複合機|ふくごうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: The office multi-function printer broke down, so I requested a repair.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly abbreviated as {複合機|ふくごうき} in everyday office language. In contrast, a single-function printer is simply ⟦プリンター→プリンター：04416_purintaa⟧. Most Japanese offices use a large shared multi-function printer rather than individual desk printers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {複合機|ふくごうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧ (to print on a multi-function printer)
- {複合機|ふくごうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リース→リース：27083_riisu⟧ (leasing a multi-function printer)
- ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧{複合機|ふくごうき} (home multi-function printer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プリンター→プリンター：04416_purintaa⟧: printer — a device for printing only
- ⟦{コピー機|こぴーき}→コピー機：23548_kopiiki⟧: copier — a device primarily for copying
